name: Golly
description: Fast, cross-platform open-source simulator for Conway's Game of Life and a wide range of other cellular automata, including Wolfram's 1D rules, Generations, Larger than Life, and custom rule tables. Golly uses the Hashlife algorithm for extremely fast computation of large or long-running patterns.
reputation: Reference tool for the cellular automata research and hobbyist community; enables exploration of Turing-complete constructions in Game of Life.
notes: Primarily an exploration and visualisation tool; no quantitative benchmark tasks. Hashlife trades memory for speed, enabling astronomical generation counts.
